notes: Static-blind: HMAC verification is present and uses hmac.compare_digest, so static WI rules pass. Bug: request.get_data(as_text=True) decodes raw bytes to a Python str using the WSGI-detected encoding, then re-encodes with .encode() before hashing. If the raw body contains non-ASCII bytes or the encoding differs from UTF-8, the bytes fed to HMAC differ from what Razorpay signed. Static rules cannot distinguish get_data() from get_data(as_text=True).
